title: Vectorized prefill assembler and decode resync handshake to reduce slip and KV churn
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: interactive workloads show decode-stage slip when many short prefill fragments arrive; frequent tiny KV writes increase eviction churn and hurt throughput. Motivation: reduce cross-stage handoff overhead and amortize kernel work by assembling micro-prefill fragments into vectorized batches that are friendly to SIMD/Warp kernels while introducing a lightweight resync handshake to prevent decode slip in high-concurrency scenarios. This PR introduces a 'vectorized prefill assembler' that coalesces contiguous prefill microchunks across sessions into fixed-size vectors, a resync token added to the runtime handshake to force deterministic decode alignment when needed, and a KV delta snapshot mechanism that batches KV writes during the assemble window to reduce eviction pressure. Design notes: - Vectorized assembler lives in runtime/prefill and exposes a small policy interface to the scheduler to dictate assembly window/timeouts. - Resync handshake is a single-bit, versioned token negotiated at handoff; it triggers a decode resync path that aligns KV cache lookups without stalling other pipelines. - KV delta snapshots create short-lived in-memory delta layers that are merged asynchronously to the main kvcache, lowering synchronous write amplification. Testing & perf: unit coverage added for assembler state machine and resync paths; end-to-end bench harness simulates 1000 concurrent small-prefill sessions with mixed sequence lengths. Results: on internal perf cluster (A100x8) with realistic prompt mixes we see +11.7% throughput at 99th percentile latency budget and median decode latency reduction of ~8ms for interactive microprefill mixes; KV eviction rate down ~30% under high churn. Feature flags added for controlled rollouts (prefill.vector_assembler, prefill.resync_handshake, kvcache.delta_snapshot). Checklist: - [x] design doc and microbenchmarks - [x] unit tests for assembler and resync - [x] integration perf harness - [x] backward compatible handshake with old agents - [x] feature flags and telemetry (prefill.assembled_count, kvcache.delta_merges) Rollout plan: staged launch behind feature flag, canary on dedicated pools for 72 hours, monitor p99/p50, KV eviction and cache hit metrics, revert via feature flag if regressions detected. Related: ENG-1824 tracks follow-up to expose assembly heuristics in console; SUP-4021 notes customer seeing high eviction during short-turn workloads.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Nice clean separation of assembler and scheduler hooks. Two concerns: 1) quantify memory overhead of in-flight vectors, 2) ensure resync path does not serialize hot decode lane. Please add a memory bound and early eviction for vectors.

Aisha Patel (author): Added a soft_memory_limit config and an early-evict policy (assembler.h) and updated the design doc with expected memory usage and mitigation. Resync path uses optimistic alignment and only falls back to stall when misalignment persists > 3 ticks.

Evan Li: KV delta merge looks good but has potential contention on merge; suggest async backoff and backpressure signals to scheduler. Also request an explanation of how snapshots affect cold-start latencies.

Aisha Patel (author): Implemented exponential backoff on merges and added telemetry-backed backpressure (kvcache.delta_backpressure). Cold-start measured +0.5ms median due to snapshot lookup, documented in perf section.

Monica Shah: Ran canary on dedicated pool - traffic profile A (short prompts) shows expected improvements; flagged a flaky test in perf harness which author fixed. Approving after author addresses two minor nits.
release_notes: Performance: Introduces vectorized prefill assembler and resync handshake to improve throughput and reduce decode slip; KV: adds delta snapshotting to lower eviction churn. Exposed behind feature flags: prefill.vector_assembler, prefill.resync_handshake, kvcache.delta_snapshot. Monitor p99 latency and kvcache.eviction_rate after rollout.
notes_for_merging: Squash-merge after CI green and Monica's final approval. Keep feature flags off by default; enable for canary pools only initially.
notes_for_ops: Watch metrics: prefill.assembled_vectors, prefill.assembly_window_ms, kvcache.delta_merges, kvcache.delta_backpressure. Revert via feature flag if p99 or eviction_rate increases.
